row.answer: Renekton is a close-range fighter/tank with an AD damage focus: his basic abilities deal physical damage and provide healing and a targeted stun, while Dominus adds nearby magic damage. His attacks build Fury that empowers abilities. Slice is a damaging dash that unlocks a second dash only if it hits an enemy.
row.counterplay: Watch his Fury and keep distance to limit his healing and targeted stun; account for another dash if Slice hits an enemy.
